push.title: L 4-5 vs Da1e FC | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 10.0. Perfect Game. I've been coaching a long time and I still got goosebumps.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your first Perfect Game for us. Write that one down and stick it on the fridge.
+ 31 passes (up from your usual 20). You made yourself big and available, and it paid off.
+ 2 key passes (up from your usual 0). You turned nothing into something more than once.
+ A hat trick against Da1e FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. Cool head, quick feet, ball in the onion bag.
+ Man of the Match, your 5th for us. You carried the moment and carried us.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Quick one: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- 64% passing (20 of 31, down from your usual 73%). Lesson of the day: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough. Clean it up and fly.
- 5 goals conceded dropped 0.1. Simple fix.
- A one-goal loss (4-5): a single moment decided it. We dug that hole together; we'll climb out together.

Training ground: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.

One thought for the road, BellyTb1: If you're gonna make a mistake, make it at full speed and learn it at half.

Go tell somebody you love about that one. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 4-5 vs Da1e FC | You: 9.6 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, I've coached a lot of games, and a 9.6 like that one still gives me goosebumps.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Da1e FC's goal. You kept testing them until something cracked.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 2). You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed.
+ Tackles attempted 6, up from your usual 3. That's the reliable kind of good.
+ Completed passes 36, up from your usual 18. Small wins add up to big ones.
+ Your vision plus BellyTb1's finishing equals a very happy coach.

THE BAD
- 1 of 4 shots on target. Old coach's advice: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. Easy as pie.
- Missed tackles 5, up from your usual 2. Tiny tweak: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.
- Giveaways 15, up from your usual 9. One honest look at that and we move forward.
- A one-goal loss (4-5): a single moment decided it. I'm not pointing fingers. I'm pointing at the mirror, mine included.

Muscle memory: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

PhogsToffees, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Every game is a teacher. Some just grade harder.

I'm proud as a peacock. - Coach Lasso
